name: community-rowan
summary: Community patch (Sheepa's list, OK'd 16 Oct): Rowan's passive heal and Dourling Caltrops; CC immunity on Rowan's and Belroth's dashes and on the Rush boon, as in Aug 2022

assets.why: Rowan, Dourling Dive (Space): immune to stun, root, charm and fear while dashing, as in Aug 2022 (Feb still has ApplyUnstoppable but never calls it). Dourling Caltrops: the vines lie on the path Rowan just dashed, behind him (Feb put them ahead of him), and their look appears there.
Rowan, Dourling Caltrops: the vines' collision box is no longer drawn in the game (the "cube").
Rowan, Dourling Caltrops: the vines look thorny like Iron Thorns instead of replaying the Dourling Dive burst, and appear where the vines are (the cue's location) instead of on Rowan.
Rowan, passive: the share of missing health healed per second is the full 2 % again, applied to his health at each tick (Feb multiplied it once by the missing share when he stepped on Overgrowth).
Rowan, passive: on Overgrowth he heals 2 % of his missing health plus 3 health per second, recomputed every quarter second, as in Aug 2022 (Feb passed the percentage as a flat amount, about 0 HP).
Rowan, passive tooltip: mentions the 3 health per second.

edits.to: </> of his <RichText.TooltipHeal>missing HP</> plus <RichText.TooltipHeal>3 HP</> per second.

assets.why: Belroth, Vicious Lunge (Space): immune to roots, stuns, charms, fears and knockbacks while lunging, as in Aug 2022 (Feb still has ApplyUnstoppable but never calls it).
Rush (boon): a stun or root no longer stops the dash; it lands when the dash ends, as in Aug 2022 (Feb flagged the dash as one crowd control cancels).
